Primary code-editing experiments provide background on concrete completion failures; December results are context only.

evidence_items.publisher: arXiv; Tal Ridnik, Dedy Kredo and Itamar Friedman
evidence_items.explanation: On CodeContests validation problems, direct prompting solved 19% with five attempts; a structured testing and revision process reached 44%. This supports substantial reliability limitations while also documenting useful capability and improvement.

The earlier refactoring benchmark documented missing implementations replaced by comments. Its deliberately challenging task selection and December timing prevent treating it as a representative early-2024 failure rate.

unresolved_gaps: The evidence does not establish a representative success rate across everyday programming requests.
Marcus supplied no numerical threshold for satisfactory performance.
